# Build

Properties of the active build profile and its output.

```rux
pub struct Build {
    pub profile: char8[..];
    pub mode: BuildMode;
    pub optimization: OptimizationMode;
    pub debugAssertions: bool;
    pub debugInfo: bool;
    pub isTest: bool;
    pub outputKind: OutputKind;
    pub timestamp: uint64;
    pub date: char8[..];
    pub time: char8[..];
}
```

Every field is fixed when compiling begins and is the same everywhere in one build. Reading one produces no
runtime code, so a branch on a field is decided while compiling and the untaken side is not emitted.

## Fields

| Name              | Type               | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `profile`         | `char8[..]`        | The profile's name as the project spelled it, which may be a project-defined profile rather than one of the two standard ones.                          |
| `mode`            | `BuildMode`        | The mode the profile implies, which is what a package should branch on.                                                                                 |
| `optimization`    | `OptimizationMode` | What the profile asked the optimizer to favor.                                                                                                          |
| `debugAssertions` | `bool`             | Whether [`DebugAssert`](/docs/api/core/diagnostics#debug-assert) checks are kept. False means they are removed without their arguments being evaluated. |
| `debugInfo`       | `bool`             | Whether debug information is emitted alongside the output.                                                                                              |
| `isTest`          | `bool`             | Whether this build is a test build, which is how a package tells a test-only path from a shipped one.                                                   |
| `outputKind`      | `OutputKind`       | The artifact being produced.                                                                                                                            |
| `timestamp`       | `uint64`           | When the build started, in seconds since the Unix epoch. Fixed once per build, so it identifies the build and does not measure time.                    |
| `date`            | `char8[..]`        | The build's start date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.                                                                                                                 |
| `time`            | `char8[..]`        | The build's start time as `HH:MM:SS`.                                                                                                                   |

## Related

<h3 id="build-mode"><code>BuildMode</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum BuildMode: uint8 {
    Debug = 0,
    Release = 1
}
```

The high-level mode of the active build profile.
A profile is a name, and more than one profile may share a mode; this is the part a package can branch on without
knowing which profiles a project defined.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Build.rux#L12)

**Cases**

| Name      | Value | Description                                                             |
| --------- | ----- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Debug`   | `0`   | Unoptimized, with debug assertions and debug information on by default. |
| `Release` | `1`   | Optimized, with debug assertions removed by default.                    |

<h3 id="optimization-mode"><code>OptimizationMode</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum OptimizationMode: uint8 {
    None = 0,
    Size = 1,
    Speed = 2
}
```

What the active build asked the optimizer to favor.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Build.rux#L21)

**Cases**

| Name    | Value | Description                                                          |
| ------- | ----- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `None`  | `0`   | No optimization: the output follows the source as closely as it can. |
| `Size`  | `1`   | Smaller output preferred where it costs speed.                       |
| `Speed` | `2`   | Faster output preferred where it costs size.                         |

<h3 id="output-kind"><code>OutputKind</code></h3>

```rux
pub enum OutputKind: uint8 {
    Executable = 0,
    SharedLibrary = 1,
    StaticLibrary = 2,
    SourceLibrary = 3
}
```

The kind of artifact the active build produces.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Build.rux#L32)

**Cases**

| Name            | Value | Description                                                         |
| --------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Executable`    | `0`   | A program with an entry point.                                      |
| `SharedLibrary` | `1`   | A library linked at load time and shipped as its own file.          |
| `StaticLibrary` | `2`   | A library linked into whatever uses it, as compiled code.           |
| `SourceLibrary` | `3`   | A library linked into whatever uses it, as source compiled with it. |

<h3 id="build-constant"><code>#build</code></h3>

```rux
pub const #build: Build;
```

The active build, as a compile-time value.
Reading a field produces no runtime code. A `when` on one keeps only the branch that applies, so the untaken side
is never resolved or type-checked and may name things this build does not have.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Build.rux#L76)
